name: Broad-Shouldered Bottle with Tortoiseshell Glaze
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；12th-14th century；Jizhou-type ware, probably Tushan ware: light gray stoneware with variegated brown and amber glazes over a white slip ground, the lower portion of the bottle coated with dark russet slip. Probably from the kilns at Tushan, Sichuan province.
